name: ProviderButtons
description: Mortar sign-in provider buttons (GitHub, Google, SSO …): one full-width secondary button per provider, stacked or in a grid. Auth SDKs supply the redirects through onSelect.

props.providers: SignInProvider[] ({ id: string; label: string; icon?: ReactNode; onSelect: () => void })
props.label: string (names the group, e.g. "Sign in with")

contract.usage: Import { ProviderButtons } from @tony-ui/mortar. Put it inside AuthLayout above or below the email form, separated by <Divider label="or continue with" soft spacing="none" />. Use full labels ("Continue with GitHub") in the list layout and short ones ("GitHub") in the grid. SignInPanel renders it for its providers.
contract.avoid: Do not restyle buttons per provider brand or put provider logos in the accessible name.
contract.accessibility: Each provider is a button named by its label; icons are decorative. Name the group with label when the buttons are not obviously about signing in.
